verdict.rationale: Attestation verification at registration is a fair question for a hardware security key. Nothing in the pack documents FIDO2/WebAuthn registration attestation, attestation certificates for Nitrokey 3 keys, or a way to restrict enrollment to approved models. The only attestation mention is a community remark that Nitrokey HSM attestation certs need a vendor shell to export. That concerns HSM key attestation, not enforcing genuine models at enrollment, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can verify device attestation at registration to enforce that only genuine, approved key models are enrolled
